general.title: MCC processing: FASTQ to WashU and CHiCAGO outputs
general.instructions: Attach the paired FASTQ reads, a reference FASTA and a CHiCAGO design directory (.rmap + .baitmap); an optional padded probe BED enables target-enrichment QC. Inputs are located automatically under /data. Outputs include the WashU long-range text and tabix track plus the CHiCAGO chinput, ibed, seqMonk and .Rds files.

parameters.name: sample_name
parameters.description: Output file prefix. Leave empty to derive it from the read 1 file name.

parameters.name: threads
parameters.description: Cores for bwa, pairtools and samtools.

parameters.name: min_mapq
parameters.description: pairtools parse --min-mapq; 40 is the protocol default.

parameters.name: design_resolution
parameters.description: Selects the attached CHiCAGO design directory by name; 10 kb suits libraries of 150M+ read pairs.

parameters.name: chicago_cutoff
parameters.description: CHiCAGO score threshold for calling significant interactions.

parameters.name: export_formats
parameters.description: CHiCAGO --export-format list; keep washU_text and washU_track for browser files.

parameters.name: filter_interactions
parameters.description: Also write a cis-only, 10 kb-2 Mb, >=5 read filtered ibed.

parameters.name: chicago_settings_file
parameters.description: Optional path to a CHiCAGO settings file (e.g. a lower minNPerBait for shallow pilot libraries).
